name: Site Version info
description: Stores a site version/build/description and exposes it on a permission-gated page and an optional API-key-gated JSON endpoint, plus a helper to push the version to a remote host.
project_description:
This module hold and show manual the site version information on site or via JSON API.

Using with the module Site Version Host allow to have an interface with multiple sites information.

 This project is simple and lightweight

 Similar Projects

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 Module configuration : /admin/config/system/site-version

Host auto config : /admin/config/system/site-version/host-autoconfig

Info view : /site-version

 Back to top 

 Configure host (Site Version Host) 
 Add sites from /admin/structure/site_version_host/manage/sites/add or Auto configure using auto config url /admin/config/services/site-version-host
